about.body: The ZSD-420 is a Ford-sourced 2.2-litre diesel inline-four engine, fitted to the Jaguar X-Type during the final years of its production run. It's part of Ford's Duratorq / Puma engine family, used across multiple Ford and Jaguar applications from 2008 onward. In the Jaguar X-Type, the ZSD-420 appeared from 2008 through to the model's discontinuation in 2010, offering diesel buyers a more modern option alongside the earlier 2.0-litre diesel units.

byModel.body: Across the X-Type, the ZSD-420 was fitted to the 2.2D variant during the final two years of production (2008–2010). The X-Type, based on the Ford Mondeo platform, shared its diesel engines with Ford's wider Duratorq family, with the 2.2-litre unit offering more torque and refinement than the earlier 2.0-litre diesel option.

compatibility.body: Because the ZSD-420 was only fitted to one Jaguar model in a single generation, the X-Type X400 (2008–2010), compatibility is relatively straightforward compared to engines spanning multiple models and generations. That said, we still match by registration/VIN to confirm your exact specification before any rebuild or replacement work begins.

items.heading: ZSD-420 in the X-Type (X400, 2008–2010)
items.body: The ZSD-420 in the X-Type 2.2D is one of the applications we work on regularly. The X-Type's final years saw this 2.2-litre diesel option introduced alongside the existing 2.0-litre diesel — and it's the engine we see more often when an X-Type diesel comes in for a rebuild. Symptoms That Justify Inspection The following symptoms don't automatically mean the ZSD-420 requires a rebuild. Proper diagnosis comes first. Rough idle (EGR issues) Loss of power (injector or DPF issues) Starting issues (injectors) Warning lights Excessive smoke
